title: Growing crowds and visitors from around the world
summary: A steady clientele and out-of-town visitors are growing; a tour from France is expected.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Have you seen the crowds grow since, since you first started? Oh yes, and, uh, also we've noticed that we're getting a steady clientele of people, uh, people that are living in the city, that are coming back, and people from out of town who have heard by word of mouth. It's growing. We have... Yes. A lot of people... Not too many people from Birmingham, though.

We have a lot of people here who now know that this is going, people throughout the country, throughout the world, as a matter of fact, who are, who are interested in hearing this music, are now coming in. People from California...
We hope to have a whole tour of people from France next year coming here.
